summary: Mobile-friendliness verification of Dubai Vize Online per user request (iPhone 14 = 390x844 and Galaxy S = 360x800). Performed full end-to-end visa application on /basvuru at 390px reaching the payment step, tested BOTH bank transfer and Stripe card checkout on mobile, verified no horizontal scroll on all 9 public pages at 390 and 360, verified sticky wizard step bar sits at exactly 86px (matches header height, 0px overlap), wizard nav buttons stack vertically on mobile with the primary CTA on top (308x48 primary, 308x44 secondary/tertiary), social dock hides Google+Instagram on phones (only WhatsApp visible) and shows all three at 1920, mobile hamburger menu exposes BAŞVURU group (Hizmet Bedelleri + Başvuru Takip), account holder on the bank-transfer block reads 'Dubai Vize Online Turizm ve Danışmanlık A.Ş.' (no stale VizeAtlas), Stripe checkout URL cs_test_... is generated and redirects successfully. Desktop regression at 1920 confirms inline wizard buttons and sticky summary aside. Only minor observation: at 360px viewport the brand-flag-pair is hidden by design (min-[380px]:flex) — deviation from the review-request wording that says flags should fit at 360.

issues: brand-flag-pair has utility 'min-[380px]:flex' so it is hidden below 380px. Review request wanted flags visible at 360/390/430; 390 and 430 pass, 360 hides them. This appears intentional to avoid crowding but conflicts with the written requirement. Consider lowering the breakpoint to min-[360px] or shrinking the flag pair to keep them visible on the narrowest phones.

action_items: (Optional / minor) If the product really wants both flags visible at 360px too, change Navbar.jsx brand-flag-pair class from 'min-[380px]:flex' to 'min-[360px]:flex' (or shrink flag width) — 390 and 430 already show them.
critical_code_review_comments: Apply.jsx is 3211 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. It aggregates the whole 4-step wizard, all forms, dropzones, extras (insurance/eSIM/tour), consents and payment logic. Splitting into per-step components (PeopleStep, VisaStep, DocsStep, SummaryStep) + WizardShell would drastically improve maintainability and testability. Not a mobile-friendliness blocker but is a strong tech-debt signal.

startPayment/startBankTransfer both re-submit the application if 'created' is null, but there is no debounce protection beyond disabled={submitting || paying}. Rapid double-clicks on mobile could still fire two POSTs before state flips. Consider a request-level guard (ref-based) as an extra safety net.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for mobile-friendliness targets; 99% overall — one minor deviation at 360px flag visibility

seed_data_creation: Two test applications created via the public flow: DV-ZD585768 (bank transfer, TEST MOBIL) and one via Stripe test checkout (TEST MOBIL2, cs_test_a1vXsvonW4LmFWqSxE2JC2nYrN0INENG0Qhow82sJCtT5yG6FJe2Ys3GGk). Both use TEST_ style fake data; no real payment completed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on preview URL. Key metrics measured live: (1) scrollWidth == innerWidth on /, /vize-tipleri, /iletisim, /takip, /gelismeler, /seyahat-sigortasi, /esim, /gerekli-belgeler, /basvuru at BOTH 390 and 360 — 0 overflow everywhere. (2) Mobile header height = 86px; sticky wizard step bar top offset = 86px → 0px overlap after scrolling (used to be 33px). (3) Wizard nav buttons stacked on mobile: next 308x48 (y=3270, on top), save 308x44 (y=3330), prev 308x44 (y=3386) — flex-col-reverse working; desktop 1920: all three at y=2051 inline (regression pass). (4) Social dock at 390: google-review-button and instagram-button both display:none; a single WhatsApp button (a[aria-label='WhatsApp']) sits bottom-right and does not overlap the pay button (pay btn is 308x48 in the wizard footer). At 1920 all three visible. (5) Mobile menu items under BAŞVURU: mobile-nav-link-vize-tipleri + mobile-nav-link-takip only (Hesabim still removed as of iteration 88). (6) Payment step: payment-method-transfer + payment-method-card both present and clickable; wizard-pay-button text swaps between 'Havale bilgilerini al' and 'Ödemeye geç'. Transfer path returns bank-transfer-details with data-testid=bank-transfer-iban and account holder text 'Dubai Vize Online Turizm ve Danışmanlık A.Ş.' (2 occurrences on page); NO 'VizeAtlas' anywhere. Card path: POST /api/payments/checkout succeeds and redirects to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... on mobile viewport. (7) Server date is 2026-09-05 (system clock) — travel dates in the past will fail submitApplication with toast 'Gidiş tarihi bugünden önce olamaz'; use future dates like 15.12.2026 during automated tests. (8) 'bank-accounts-section' (BankAccounts.jsx component with bank-card-*/bank-iban-*/bank-copy-*) is NOT rendered on Apply.jsx summary — it lives on BankTransferInfo.jsx / VisaTypes.jsx. Apply.jsx uses its own inline bank-transfer-details block instead. If the requirement really wants copyable TL+USD IBANs on the wizard summary itself, main agent should either mount <BankAccounts/> inside bank-transfer-details or add IBAN copy testids there. (9) The IBAN currently rendered on the wizard is the placeholder 'TR00 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 00' — this reads directly from site_settings.bank_transfer.iban in DB; ensure production seed populates a real IBAN before go-live. (10) 360px: brand-flag-pair is hidden by the Tailwind utility min-[380px]:flex. Logo (200x56) + hamburger (44x44) still fit with 84px gap and no overlap.
rca of the issue: N/A — all previously reported mobile issues (33px sticky header overlap, floating dock covering CTAs, iOS 16px auto-zoom, stale VizeAtlas name, non-tappable wizard buttons) are resolved and verified. The only remaining minor item is the 360px flag visibility, which is a design choice, not a bug.
